name: Cloud sessions
description: Claude Code on the web's sessions in a sidebar panel and a tab of their own, live: which need you, which are working and which are ready for review, with their repository, branch and pull request, and their news in the Inbox. Every claude.ai account the Browser is signed in to shows (each workspace's logins, each container, each organization); pick one to see its sessions, or all of them. A click opens a session in the logins it belongs to; continue one here in a terminal, or archive it. Start a new one, or one from a note, in the account you pick.

read.label: Read your sessions
read.description: reads your sessions from claude.ai with the Browser's logins; until you say, the panel asks, once a page of the Browser is signed in to claude.ai

hidden.label: Hidden accounts
hidden.description: claude.ai accounts not shown nor read, by the name the panel gives them: a login's email, or a team's name (the panel's account picker sets it too)
